load_bearing_verifications.claim: The acute visit record documents topical salicylic-acid treatment of two plantar warts before the first documented flare.
load_bearing_verifications.primary_source: Disclosed project-lead acute visit record dated 2023-02-20; underlying health record remains private

load_bearing_verifications.claim: The exact PubMed topical-salicylic-acid plus urate/gout query returned no records.
Systemic low-dose aspirin was associated with recurrent gout attacks in a case-crossover cohort of people with established gout.
In four psoriasis patients receiving repeated large-area occlusive salicylic-acid treatment, more than 60% of applied acid was absorbed while serum salicylate did not exceed 5 mg/100 mL.
A severe topical salicylate intoxication case used 40% salicylic-acid ointment over approximately 41% of body surface area.

limitations: This was a bounded medication differential, not a systematic review; several broad PubMed searches reached retrieval caps or were dominated by treatment-related term overlap.
A zero-result or incidental-overlap query does not exclude a rare idiosyncratic drug event.
Only six regional searches from the wider native-language plan were executed; CQVIP was broad, WanFang returned an application shell, and KCI did not return results.
No non-English source supplied a load-bearing claim, so the two-model translation protocol was not triggered.
The topical salicylate studies involved extensive diseased skin or toxic exposure and cannot quantify systemic exposure from two treated warts.
Chronology was established for the topical salicylic-acid exposure; the scan did not establish that every other queried medication preceded the flare.
errors: WanFang returned a JavaScript shell without a parseable result set.
KCI returned a redirect/alert response rather than search results.
